raw_text: New satellite imagery shows massive PLA infrastructure buildup opposite Arunachal Pradesh. China's claims over Zangnan are being backed by concrete military positioning. The Indian side appears unprepared for this escalation. This is cognitive warfare transitioning to kinetic readiness.
